ipeds.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - Georgia Southern University (fall 2024 admissions, test scores, enrollment)

ipeds_api.title: NCES IPEDS fall 2024 admissions counts and nonresident-alien undergraduates (Urban Institute Education Data Portal)

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS fall 2024 (College Navigator percentages; exact counts from the NCES IPEDS ADM2024 file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal). A Common Data Set for 2025-2026 is listed on Georgia Southern's Digital Commons but its file is blocked behind a bot challenge and could not be read as text, so no CDS figures (international applicants/admits, GPA, SAT total, factors) are included. International undergraduates (327) are IPEDS fall 2024 nonresident aliens, about 1.4% of 23,541 undergraduates; the international page says about 500 students who are not U.S. citizens attend across all levels. College Navigator listed SAT/ACT as 'test optional' for fall 2024, but current admissions pages require scores.
